officialText:
Any retaining structure, standing partly on the land of each owner, may be removed by either owner when the original reason for the erection of such retaining structure ceases to exist. Notification shall be provided to the adjoining property owner.

(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
